toegepas.voor: in wat nou die Noordwes-provinsie is
toegepas.na: in die gebied wat nou die Noordwes-provinsie is
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'In wat nou ... is' copies English 'in what is now'; naming the area reads more naturally in Afrikaans and keeps the protected name intact.
toegepas.fout: 'in wat nou ... is' copies English 'in what is now' and reads stiffly
toegepas.rede_keurder: Naming the area is the natural Afrikaans construction, adds no fact, and leaves the protected name and 'klip-ommuurde' intact.

toegepas.rede_vinder: Two 'in' phrases in a row read clumsily; 'gedurende' separates place from time.
toegepas.fout: two 'in' phrases in a row run place and time together clumsily
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Gedurende' separates the time from the place without changing who, what or when.

toegepas.voor: Van die klipmure sien ons vandag die ruïnes.
toegepas.na: Vandag sien ons die ruïnes van die klipmure.
toegepas.rede_vinder: Fronting 'Van die klipmure' is awkward; the natural order puts the time first and keeps 'ruïnes van die klipmure' together.
toegepas.fout: fronting 'Van die klipmure' is awkward and splits 'ruïnes van die klipmure'
toegepas.rede_keurder: The natural word order reads more easily and keeps both protected words unchanged.

laat_vaar.voor: daarmee met ander groepe handel gedryf
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Daarmee handel gedryf' is stiff and loosely attached; 'dit verhandel' says plainly that the metals were traded.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Daarmee handel gedryf' is natural Afrikaans, and 'dit verhandel' narrows trading with the worked metal to selling the metals themselves, so it is at best a lateral move.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The noun 'bewys' reads more naturally with the article here.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Is bewys van' without an article is standard Afrikaans, so adding 'n' is only a different reading.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Beskilder' is the idiomatic verb for decorating a surface with patterns; 'geverf' can suggest simply painting the car a colour.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Met Ndebele-patrone geverf' is already clear and matches the paragraph's 'manier van verf', so 'beskilder' is a lateral and slightly harder word for Grade 5.
